title: Limit-name registry
description: The names a resource_exhausted problem body carries in limit_name, each the limit the request crossed. See schemas/registry/README.md. tools/validate_limit_registry.py checks sort order, uniqueness and the package mirror, which this schema cannot express.

format_version.description: The registry format's own version, pinned to the version this schema validates.

entries.description: Every limit name, sorted by name.

name.description: The unique, upper-snake-case spelling clients match on.

definition.description: One sentence saying what the limit bounds.

owning_contract.description: The short name of the contract that owns the limit, spelled as in the code registry.
